name: Remind to create spec when new module folder is created
description: When a new module folder is created inside src/modules/, reminds the developer to use the Kiro spec workflow instead of writing code directly. Links them to the correct spec template.

action.prompt:
A new NestJS module was just created at ${file}. Extract the module name from the file path.

Check if a corresponding spec file exists at .kiro/specs/{module-name}/requirements.md.

If it does NOT exist, respond with:
'⚠️ No spec found for this module. Before writing any more code:
1. Open .kiro/specs/ and find the matching spec for this module
2. If it doesn't exist yet, create it by running a Kiro spec session first
3. The spec defines the requirements, design, and tasks — code should follow the spec, not precede it

Spec files available: list the files in .kiro/specs/'

If the spec DOES exist, respond with:
'✅ Spec found at .kiro/specs/{module-name}/. Proceeding with implementation that matches the spec.'
action.description: Check if a spec exists for the new module
